rulings.ruling: Ruling: equivalent; project retained. Line 12 is never more than lines 9 and 10 ('Add lines 9 and 10, but don't enter more than line 11'), so lines 9 + 10 - 12 is never negative and the project's floor at zero changes nothing.

Ruling: second transcription right in substance, resolved by refusal (owner, BUG-0062). On a separate return line 2 includes the spouse's section 179 property (i4562 p. 4, Line 2) and the line 5 limitation is shared (p. 5); the project now refuses a section 179 election or carryover on a separate return (s179.mfs, on line 5). On every other return line 2 is the same sum on both sides.

Ruling: second transcription right in substance, resolved by refusal (owner, BUG-0062).
